question: What was the month-over-month change in delivered revenue during 2018?
sql: WITH monthly_revenue AS (SELECT t1.month_start AS month, round(sum(t2.order_value), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.dim_dates AS t1 INNER JOIN marts.fct_orders AS t2 ON t1.date_key = t2.order_date WHERE t2.is_delivered AND t1.year = 2018 GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, revenue, lag(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue, round(revenue - lag(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS mom_change, round(case when lag(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month) = 0 then null else (revenue - lag(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / lag(revenue, 1) OVER (ORDER BY month) end, 2) AS mom_pct_change FROM monthly_revenue ORDER BY month
label: ok
